records.text: The 2022 World Cup match between Brazil and Croatia drew 6.1 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And when people streamed it, ... it looks like the 2022 World Cup comes into the second spot Brazil versus Croatia when it was streamed on YouTube, ... 6.1 million people tuned in again.

verification.notes: Streaming analytics records 6.1 million peak viewers on Casimito's YouTube channel for Brazil-Croatia. FIFA separately reported a larger 6.9 million cross-platform peak for partner streams, so the 6.1 million statement is accurate as a YouTube-channel figure.

records.text: Nick Shirley said that within two days he gained access to members of Comando Vermelho and interviewed gang members in Brazil's largest favela.
records.speaker: Nick Shirley

appearances.snippet: Through the course of two days, I was able to get access to one of Rio's largest gangs, Commando Vermelho, and befriend a few of their soldiers who are so dangerous they cannot even leave the favela. ... Lots of strange things happened to find myself on top of Brazil's largest favela in a destroyed house interviewing gang members of one of the largest gangs in Brazil.

verification.notes: Shirley's published video and a contemporary Brazilian report document that he presented a two-day visit to Rocinha and an interview with people represented as Comando Vermelho members. This verifies Shirley made and published the account; the masked participants' identities and gang affiliation are not independently authenticated.
